name: shoot.on_day
description: The shoot day picked on an idea's page: the idea joins the shoot already on that day, or a new planned shoot starts there at the time picked, under the client's id.
sql:
with there as (
  select * from brandbase.shoots where brand_id = :brand and day = :day::date order by start, id limit 1
),
already as (select exists (select 1 from there where :ideaId = any (idea_ids)) as yes),
keep as (select coalesce((select id from there), :newShootId) as id),
emptied as (
  delete from brandbase.shoots s using keep, already
  where not already.yes and s.brand_id = :brand and s.origin = 'planned' and s.id <> keep.id
    and cardinality(array_remove(s.idea_ids, :ideaId)) = 0
  returning s.id
),
taken as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array_remove(s.idea_ids, :ideaId), version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from keep, already
  where not already.yes and s.brand_id = :brand and s.id <> keep.id and :ideaId = any (s.idea_ids)
    and s.id not in (select id from emptied)
  returning s.id
),
joined as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = s.idea_ids || :ideaId, version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from there t where s.id = t.id and not (:ideaId = any (t.idea_ids))
  returning s.*
),
made as (
  insert into brandbase.shoots (id, brand_id, title, origin, day, start, "end", place, idea_ids)
  select :newShootId, :brand, coalesce(btrim(:title), 'New shoot'), 'planned', :day::date,
    (brandbase.hours_after('12:00', '17:00', :start, null))[1],
    (brandbase.hours_after('12:00', '17:00', :start, null))[2], coalesce(:place, ''), array[:ideaId]
  where not exists (select 1 from there)
  returning *
),
people as (
  insert into brandbase.crew (id, shoot_id, brand_id, name, role, position)
  select c ->> 'id', m.id, :brand, btrim(c ->> 'name'), btrim(c ->> 'role'), (n - 1)::int
  from made m, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(:crew::jsonb, '[]')) with ordinality t(c, n)
  returning *
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(j), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = j.id), '[]')) as result from joined j
union all
select brandbase.shoot_json(t) from there t where not exists (select 1 from joined)
union all
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from people p), '[]')) from made m
